data.body:
Landed as a42379a112 (Gerrit change 1661, LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, submitted by RebarBotNava). Gerrit rebased server-side, so the landed sha differs from the locally-committed cde4c2ccec; the worktree was realigned onto gerrit/main and the ACs re-verified against the LANDED tree.

Implementation: the probe allowlist reaches the batch step through the EXISTING generic with_inputs seam (a batch step's 'with:' is resolved once by the interpreter into BatchRunRequest.with_inputs, which this runner already read three keys from), so BatchRunRequest is unchanged and no plan-review concept leaks onto the generic seam. _project_criteria filters the project fan-in to ids IN the allowlist, mirroring workflow_ops' built-in probe filter, rather than blanket-suppressing -- so it stays correct if the allowlist ever grows.

Plan review: BLOCK on the first pass for a real miss -- my Tests section enumerated only ONE _project_criteria monkeypatch stub (test_pass1_finder_model.py:103) when there were TWO; test_model_class_ladder.py:143 carried the identical 2-positional-arg lambda and would have raised TypeError once the call site passed a third argument. Fixed by enumerating the whole population via a string grep (the monkeypatch target is invisible to Serena) and adding a machine-checkable AC that fails while any instance remains. PASS + signed on re-review.

Verified on the landed tree: runners.py untouched (no field added to BatchRunRequest); the caveat naming this ticket is gone; both stubs accept the new argument; plan-review.yaml passes inputs.probe_criteria to the finders batch. Local gates: make lint PASS, make typecheck PASS (509 files), targeted units 47 passed, wider workflow/plan-review sweep 725 passed.
